Paint Protection Film (PPF)

Services/Paint Protection Film (PPF)

The Middle East climate's relentless heat, UV and airborne grit wear down factory paint fast. Our layered protection systems — including self-healing PPF, vinyl wrapping, ceramic and graphene coatings — guard every panel, preserving depth, shine and resale value for years.

All Paint Protection Film (PPF) Services

Paint Protection Film (PPF)

Self-healing TPU film absorbs rock chips and road debris, keeping panels flawless underneath.

Ceramic Coating

Hydrophobic ceramic layer locks in gloss and repels dust, water and contaminants for years.

Graphene Coating Protection

Next-generation graphene matrix providing extreme heat dissipation and anti-spotting defence.

Scratch Removal & Swirl Correction

Machine polishing erases scratches and swirl marks, restoring deep, mirror-clear reflections.
